name: agentic-github-flow-web-deploy
description: Pre-deploy hardening check for a website on Vercel with Supabase and optional Google sign-in.

interface.shortDescription: Pre-deploy hardening check for a website on Vercel with Supabase and optional Google sign-in.
interface.longDescription: Reads the repository (migrations, configuration, headers, auth flow, dependencies) and gives the user a dashboard checklist and a ready or not-ready verdict. Deploys nothing and touches no live project.
